execution: Actual installed CRAN mgcv 1.9-4, with unmodified source family algebra. Normal tests use committed static captures and require no R. Numerical inputs are frozen JSON, not regenerated at test time.
scope: Three-predictor log/identity/sqrt mean links, identity transformed-power/log-dispersion links and bounded power. Analytic gradient/Hessian from ldTweedie, vector parameters, zeros, offsets, penalized/unscaled initialization, fixed/EFS fits, Bayesian/frequentist covariance, EDF, criterion, AIC/logLik, null fit/null deviance, fitted/prediction/SE/residuals, public natural parameters/mean/components/persistence.
boundaries: available.derivs=0 supplies only first/second likelihood derivatives; EFS smoothing uses no invented third/fourth derivatives or numerical outer fallback.
Source gam.setup.list rejects global fixed-SP input when a parametric-only middle predictor precedes another smooth; the fixed-SP R capture sets the same SP inside each smooth formula instead.
Source ll ignores prior weights; deviance residuals and null deviance apply source weights. tw.null.fit defaults retain their independent a=1.001,b=1.999 bounds.

efs_initialization.historical_status: Retained unchanged as provenance, not a portable source endpoint assertion. initial.spg uses the initially reparameterized design with original penalties; arbitrary Sl eigenvector signs change source starting SP and finite EFS endpoints.
efs_initialization.comparison: Predicted functions, full prediction covariance, transported design and penalties, EDF, likelihood and criterion; unchanged 2e-7 numerical parity tolerance.
